question: Which supervised browser driver executes authorized browser action envelopes outside the Tauri application WebView?
selected_option: Run a pinned Playwright supervisor as a separate local process managed by the Rust daemon, using isolated browser contexts, resilient locators, actionability checks, events, traces, and an explicit Chromium-only raw-CDP escape hatch behind the same effect gate.
rationale: The user explicitly selected OPT-BROWSER-PLAYWRIGHT-SUPERVISOR. It provides a mature high-level interaction model and evidence surface while keeping browser lifecycle and implementation failures outside the Rust semantic kernel; narrowly typed raw CDP remains available only where the high-level protocol cannot express a reviewed Chromium-specific operation.

required_semantics: the Playwright supervisor is a separate least-privileged local process managed by the Rust daemon and never becomes the accepted-state semantic authority
only the daemon can submit a browser action envelope; desktop, CLI, remote, agent, and WebAssembly clients cannot connect to Playwright or its browser endpoint directly

each action envelope binds request, actor, workspace, browser-session, page, expected revision, capability, effect-policy, origin, action, target, input-handle, credential-handle, idempotency, deadline, and evidence identities
the exact Playwright release, supervisor source digest, runtime identity, browser family, browser build, launch arguments, and protocol compatibility are pinned and recorded
new sessions use isolated non-persistent browser contexts by default; persistent or authenticated contexts require an explicit credential and storage-state policy
browser launch, endpoint discovery, readiness, health, reconnect, cancellation, graceful shutdown, forced termination, orphan cleanup, and bounded restart are owned by the daemon supervisor contract

navigation, redirects, popups, dialogs, permission prompts, downloads, uploads, new origins, credential use, raw CDP, and external protocol handlers are intercepted and routed through the selected browser-effect policy
the supervisor never implicitly retries an action whose external effect may have occurred; disconnect, timeout, crash, or missing confirmation after dispatch yields an explicit uncertain outcome
traces, screenshots, DOM or accessibility snapshots, requests, responses, downloads, console output, and CDP observations are bounded and redacted before evidence storage
raw CDP is Chromium-only, disabled by default, limited to versioned typed operations absent from the high-level driver, and crosses the same capability and effect gates as every other action
browser observations and receipts are evidence only and cannot accept Essays content, mutate canonical state, or prove an external effect succeeded
non_implications: selecting Playwright does not select the exact release, JavaScript runtime, browser build, launch mode, profile location, packaging, update, or installation mechanism
Playwright auto-waiting and actionability checks do not prove that an action is authorized, idempotent, harmless, or externally successful
an isolated browser context is not a complete security boundary and does not authorize credential persistence or secret exposure
a trace or screenshot may contain sensitive data and is not automatically admissible evidence

this decision does not satisfy the browser effect-policy, security-owner, or Work Owner gates and does not authorize dependency installation, browser launch, navigation, credential use, downloads, uploads, external effects, release, or deployment

owner_gate.required_owner: Essays Project owner plus Essays security owner plus Work Owner effect-policy owner
owner_gate.effect_until_satisfied: Playwright installation, browser launch, navigation, credential use, and browser effects prohibited

remaining_blockers: browser approval, credential, navigation, popup, dialog, permission, download, upload, uncertain-outcome, retry, and evidence policy
Essays security-owner and Work Owner review of the browser driver and effect policy
exact pinned Playwright, JavaScript runtime, browser build, packaging, launch, and supervisor protocol identities
Essays security-owner review of the remote authentication binding and WebAssembly policies
remote capability authorization and grant semantics
Product Capability decision and dependent contracts
authored ontology closure and DomainSpec generation
deferred_decisions: Cross-browser parity and any raw-CDP operation catalog remain deferred until the first browser family and required effect operations are frozen.
